Dear Men who said that Ruth shouldn’t have been out to late,

Ruth, as a human being, should’ve been able to move around as she pleased. The problem wasn’t the time of day/night, the problem was a man. Essentially, y’all are the problem.  

#YesAllWomen #MeToo
I have so many stories about what I've been through when rejecting men, it's crazy. Never happens when I reject women; studs just go on about their day. #YesALLWomen #MeToo
